title: Heartleaf matching RGBA terrain splats
creator: Softmax / Polyworld contributors, with Codex and built-in imagegen
generationMode: Built-in image_gen for opacity only, followed by Nim/Pixie compositing and export
process: Generate a separate grayscale opacity atlas with distinct feathered organic masks for the nine existing terrain materials.
Regenerate only paving coverage without internal slab shapes, then retain the original first six masks pixel-for-pixel using the local preparation helper.
Apply smoothstep((gray - 4) / 200) times a cell border guard that stays zero through eight source pixels and reaches full strength after another 24 pixels.
Preserve all source RGB channels exactly. Reuse the existing tile height master without modification at source resolution.
Export each pair independently at 256x256. Filter height through the same source alpha as color, store height opaque and zero outside coverage. Do not multiply relief by opacity.

validation.sourceColorPreservation: All source RGB channels checked equal to the tile color master before export
validation.sourceHeightPreservation: Stamp height master checked byte-for-byte equal to the tile height master
validation.pairContracts: All nine exported pairs passed dimensions, transparent borders, nonempty color, opaque grayscale height and zero-height-outside-alpha checks
validation.coverage: Every exported stamp contains transparent, partially covered and fully opaque pixels
validation.roundTrip: All 18 exported PNGs passed lossless encode/decode comparison
validation.visualReview: Inspected all nine on light and dark grounds, rotated alpha and height overlaps, and repetition comparisons
validation.nimCheck: Local preparation and preview helpers passed nim check; preview verification passed in release mode
validation.runtimeRender: Not integrated into or tested in the game engine
